title: [GMCP 203.048.M] Mastery: Independent GMCP qualification and continuously complete release gate
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-048-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: One hermetic qualification command reconstructs the requirements ledger, builds clean artifacts, runs unit/integration/conformance/extension/interop/security/fuzz/platform/performance/recovery/doc tests, verifies evidence provenance, and emits a signed human-readable scorecard. Release is allowed only with 100% applicable requirements traced and passing, zero unexplained compatibility gaps, zero unresolved critical/high security findings and every VC-203 mastery gate green; new standards or accepted metrics automatically reopen qualification until classified. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
